name: Ananias
summary: A man in the early church who sold land with his wife Sapphira but kept back part of the price. Peter said he had lied to God, and he fell down dead.

key_moments.title: Keeping Back Part
key_moments.description: Ananias and his wife Sapphira sold a piece of property. With her knowledge he kept back part of the money and brought only the rest to the apostles.

key_moments.title: A Lie Told to God
key_moments.description: Peter asked Ananias why he had let Satan fill his heart, and said he had lied not to men but to God. When Ananias heard this he fell down and died, and everyone who heard about it was filled with fear.
